breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Neglect atmospheric pressure' and uses NPSHa = –hs – hL – Pv/(ρg), which is identical to the flawed incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires including atmospheric pressure as NPSHa = (p_atm/(ρg)) – hs – hL – (Pv/(ρg)) with p_atm = 101.3 kPa. This inconsistency was not resolved.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still omits atmospheric pressure from the NPSH formula, meaning it treats the reservoir surface pressure as zero (gauge) while subtracting vapor pressure in absolute terms (3.2 kPa absolute). This gauge/absolute mixing error persists. The ground truth resolves this by consistently using absolute pressures, including the p_atm/(ρg) term.
